note: 待 wait has 彳 (going person); 持 hold has 扌 (hand); 特 special has 牛 (cow).
未 not yet: top line SHORTER. 末 end: top line LONGER (the end sticks out).
土 earth: bottom line longer (ground is wide). 士 samurai: top line longer.
人 person: right stroke leans on the left. 入 enter: left stroke leans on the right.
右 right: ナ + 口. 石 stone: 一 + ノ + 口 — the ノ starts under the top line.
右 right has 口 (mouth — you eat with your right hand). 左 left has 工.
休 rest: person + 木 tree (resting by a tree). 体 body: person + 本.
午 noon: vertical line stops at the top. 牛 cow: vertical line pokes through (a horn).
大 big: no dot. 犬 dog: dot top-right (an ear). 太 fat: dot at the bottom.
天 heaven: top line shorter, nothing pokes through. 夫 husband: vertical pokes through the top.
日 sun: 1 inner line. 目 eye: 2 inner lines. 白 white: 日 + a dot on top. 自 self: 目 + a dot on top.
千 thousand starts with a slanted ノ. 干 dry has a flat top line.
木 tree. 本 book/origin: line across the root. 未/末: extra top line — short (未) or long (末).
王 king: no dot. 玉 jewel: dot bottom-right. 主 master: dot on top.
力 power: the vertical stroke pokes through the top. 刀 sword: it does not.
見 see: 目 + 儿 legs (eyes on legs). 貝 shellfish: 目 + ハ.
All inside 門 gate: 間 interval has 日, 問 question has 口 (mouth asks), 聞 hear has 耳 (ear).
買 buy: 罒 + 貝 (money shell). 売 sell: 士 + 冖 + 儿.
外 outside: 夕 + 卜. 夕 evening: one 夕. 多 many: two 夕 stacked.
東 east: 木 with 日 inside. 車 car: 田-like box with a line through.
気 spirit: 气 + メ. 汽 steam: 氵 water + 气 (no メ).
All under 广: 店 shop has 占, 広 wide has ム, 度 degree has 廿 + 又.
早 early. 草 grass: 艹 + 早.
Same left side. 新 new: 斤 axe on the right. 親 parent: 見 see on the right (parents watch).
字 character: 宀 roof. 学 study: ⺍ + 冖 (three dots on top).
小 small: 3 strokes. 少 few: 小 + an extra slanted ノ stroke.
今 now: ㇇ hook at the bottom. 会 meet: 云 at the bottom. 令 order: 卩 at the bottom.
北 north: two people back to back. 比 compare: two ヒ side by side.
文 writing: 亠 + 乂. 父 father: ハ + メ. 交 mix: 亠 + 父.
住 live: 亻 person + 主. 注 pour: 氵 water + 主. 主 master alone.
鳥 bird: four dots at the bottom (feet). 島 island: 山 mountain at the bottom.
音 sound. 意 mind: 音 + 心 heart. 暗 dark: 日 + 音.
低 low: 亻 person. 底 bottom: 广 roof.
使 use: 亻 + 吏. 便 convenience: 亻 + 更.
Both share the 𦰩 body. 漢 Chinese adds 氵 water on the left. 難 difficult adds 隹 bird on the right.
開 open: 开 inside the gate. 閉 close: 才 inside the gate.
重 heavy. 動 move: 重 + 力 power. 働 work: 亻 person + 動.
Both have 斗. 料 fee/material: 米 rice on the left. 科 subject: 禾 grain on the left.
内 inside: one 人 in 冂. 肉 meat: two 人 in 冂.
西 west: line on top, legs bent inside. 四 four: closed box with 儿 inside.
万 ten thousand: no dot. 方 direction: dot on top.
田 rice field: closed box. 由 reason: vertical line pokes out the top.
百 hundred: 一 + 白.
足 foot: 口 on top. 走 run: 土 on top.
昼 daytime: 尺 + 日 + 一. 書 write: 聿 brush + 日. 画 picture: 一 + 由 inside 凵.
All have 言 speech. 読 read: 売. 語 language: 吾. 話 talk: 舌 tongue.
牛 cow: vertical line is straight. 手 hand: starts with ノ and ends with a hook.
雨 rain. 電 electricity: ⻗ rain + 电. 雪 snow: ⻗ rain + ヨ.
円 yen: 冂 with a short box inside. 用 use: two vertical lines through.
Both contain 斤 axe: 近 near adds ⻌ movement; 所 place adds 戸 door.
寺 temple. 時 time: 日 + 寺. 持 hold: 扌 + 寺.
